name: Software Engineering (MScSE)
subtitle: 🚧 Study plan coming soon · 36 CH
bio: Master's program preparing professional software engineers, entrepreneurs and leaders able to develop competitive, reliable solutions and contribute to the software industry in Palestine. 36 credit hours: 18 CH compulsory courses, 12 CH electives, plus 6 CH either Thesis (Path A) or two Seminars (Path B). Up to 9 CH of remedial courses (Statistics, Advanced Programming, Data Structure, Database Management Systems) may also apply. 🚧 Per-course credit hours and semester placement weren't given, so the interactive study plan isn't available yet.
